text:
Sam (support): Heads-up — BrightCart reporting repeated 429s during a morning surge. They say scale-up is taking too long and requests are queueing. Warm pool stays near 0.
Maya (customer-success): Customer timeline: spike started ~09:12 UTC, saw ~30% error rate for ~6m. They pasted logs showing backoff between attach probes increasing over time.
Jordan (eng-platform): I pulled the autoscaler logs for that tenant. We're seeing probe retries with randomized jitter up to ~18s between attempts. A lot of probe failures are imagepull/timeouts from noisy-node throttling. Snippet:
```json
{"ts":"4955009998","level":"WARN","msg":"probe failed","tenant":"brightcart","pod":"attach-probe-7f9","reason":"ImagePullBackOff","retry_backoff_ms":12000}
{"ts":"4955009999","level":"WARN","msg":"probe failed","tenant":"brightcart","pod":"attach-probe-7f9","reason":"timeout","retry_backoff_ms":18000}
```
Priya (eng-runtime): Also correlated with GPU IO saturation on node pool-3; kubelet reported image pulls queued and container start latencies spiked. Autoscaler increments only after attach probe succeeds (we count warm-ready instances), so jitter + imagepull delays equal stretched scale-up. Current tenant config: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=10, target_rps_per_replica=50. During spike they needed ~8 replicas.
OpsBot: [system] deployment event: warmpool-prepull triggered for tenant brightcart at 4955010000
Jordan (eng-platform): Short repro steps I ran locally: 1) hit /v1/generate on dedicated endpoint at 100 RPS for 90s 2) watch attach probe logs and warmpool metrics 3) observe rollup: probes failing, retries with jitter. Commands:
```
# run load
hey --concurrency 20 --rate 100 https://dedicated.redwood.example/v1/generate
kubectl -n dedicated-prod get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=attach-probe-*-brightcart -w
```
Maya (customer-success): Customer asks for immediate workaround — they are in prod and traffic is time-sensitive.
Sam (support): Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) bump tenant min_replicas to 6 to absorb the spike (reduces need to rely on probes) 2) set PROBE_JITTER=0 for that autoscaler roll (disable randomized backoff for critical tenants) 3) pre-pull images into warmpool nodes for their region. I can coordinate the config changes if eng approves.
Priya (eng-runtime): Agree. I'll open a quick PR to add a tenant-level override for probe jitter and a runtime flag to prefer deterministic backoff when cluster congestion metric > threshold. Longer term we should make probe backoff adaptive using node congestion signals (imagepull queue length, node IO).
Jordan (eng-platform): I'll schedule the min_replicas bump and run a controlled warmpool pre-pull. Also adding a temporary auto-evict policy for noisy tenants on pool-3 to free imagepull bandwidth.
Maya (customer-success): Customer accepts the min_replicas bump and pre-pull. Wants confirmation when done.
Sam (support): On it — will update BrightCart. ETA for changes: min_replicas + pre-pull in ~12m, PROBE_JITTER toggle requires eng PR then can be toggled via config within ~40m if approved.
Priya (eng-runtime): Filing tracking issue: "adaptive-probe-backoff-based-on-node-congestion" with owner @Priya. Will include test matrix for bursty traffic and noisy neighbor scenarios.
Jordan (eng-platform): For the record, suggested long-term fixes: 1) count in-progress attach attempts toward capacity sooner (speculative counting) 2) ensure warmpool image prefetch for reserved tenants 3) surface probe failure telemetry to customer console.
Sam (support): Thanks all. I'll post customer update after min_replicas bump completes. :white_check_mark:
Maya (customer-success): Thanks team.
OpsBot: [system] config-change applied: min_replicas=6 for tenant brightcart at 4955010300
Sam (support): Confirmed with customer — error rate dropped to ~1% after bump and pre-pull, monitoring for 15m window. They'll keep us posted if it reoccurs.
Priya (eng-runtime): Noted — will follow up when PR is ready.
Jordan (eng-platform): Closing triage for immediate escalation; will keep tracking issue open for the adaptive backoff work.
Maya (customer-success): Closing loop with customer now.
